== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Elder cultists are groups of human worshipers dedicated to the [[Great Elders]]. While many individuals are recruited through exploitation, such as brainwashing, misinformation, or targeting the uneducated and emotionally vulnerable, some join because they genuinely believe these entities will provide salvation. These followers engage in various rituals, which can include extreme physical mutilation like self-blinding to demonstrate their devotion. Some cultists may even [[sacrifice]] their own lives to provide vitality for the [[Elder wall]]. Various factions exist within this movement, including the [[Sleepless]]—a collective formed by groups like the [[Lamplighters]], the [[Sisters of the Fading Moon]], and the [[Eyes of Crossing]]—as well as the [[Thousand Eyes]]. These organizations may work to create division among human [[Guilds]], potentially serving the interests of the [[Great Elders]]. While some view these cultists as a confirmed reality, others may only see them as part of the broader mystery surrounding the [[Elders]]. The cults are often associated with ritualistic activities that can descend into chaos when interrupted.}}
